annotations.text:
Four directions for the box above the CostGuard table.

The axis: how much room should this take, and what should it foreground — the number kept, or where the rest went?

A and D show the same four-part split at two very different sizes. B is the only one that answers "where did it go". C is the only one that reads across a room.

A carries a Scenario tweak — Ledger or Executive — so you can see it with the table beneath it and without.

Whichever you pick gets built into both /costguard and /costguard-hub so the two screens stop disagreeing about how the same money is shown.
